decisions.reason: The connector-placement change does not alter the three-board architecture or the functional roles and exclusions of the main and sensor boards.
Repositioning lower connectors does not change ESP32 pin coverage, breakout format, breakout-hole placement, or platform purpose.
The source concerns lower connectors on the main-board layout, not the power board's form factor, mounting, or connector constraints.
The requested lower-connector arrangement does not modify the requirement to place the ESP32 antenna at the PCB edge.
The source proposes a component and connector arrangement but does not change the board dimensions or the existing requirement to preserve sufficient routing space.
Main-board connector placement does not affect the power board's four-layer stack requirement.
The source changes physical placement and orientation on the main board without changing the sensor-board connector matrix, references, pinouts, or count.
The source does not identify or change the charge-status connector, LED path, resistor configuration, or population rules.
The reset interface remains a panel-mounted control attached through J_RESET; the general lower-connector layout change does not alter its functional state.
The physical placement change does not alter the interboard power topology, connector references, connector types, matching rule, or pinout.
The source does not change the panel power button's connector, main-board location, PWRON signal connection, mounting, or switch behavior.
The source changes general connector placement but does not alter the panel controls' connector identities, GPIO assignments, mounting, or off-board interface requirement.
